title: discovery.py: Time wraparound not handled in _prune_seen
description: Line 252: Unlike _is_suppressed (lines 245-247), _prune_seen does not handle timestamp wraparound. When now < v[1] due to clock wrap or reset, (now - v[1]) becomes negative, which is less than suppress_window_ms, so entries are incorrectly kept instead of pruned. This causes stale entries to accumulate and memory to grow after a time wraparound. The impact is limited to memory growth since _is_suppressed correctly handles negative elapsed time.
